angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 797,272 km at 31.07 pc = 0.34 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 32.1855 +/- 0.0242 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 31.07 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.146 +/- 0.026 solar radii from Liu et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract): 797,272 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.04 +/- 0.05 solar masses from Liu et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5968 +/- 96 K from Liu et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Liu et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 50554 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026AJ....172...72L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-50554.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.337, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 50554 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Xiao et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023RAA....23e5022X/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 50554 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.02 dex, from Xiao et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023RAA....23e5022X/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 50554 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.17543, from Perrier et al. 2003 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2003A&A...410.1039P/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 50554 (pscomppars): age 2.16 Gyr, from Liu et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014RAA....14.1447L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/A+A/684/A28/tablea1 (Evolution of lithium in FGK dwarfs), column Prot: 11 d, the row 0.1 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.146 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.736. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
